scripts.build: python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')]"
scripts.clean: python3 -c "import pathlib, shutil; [shutil.rmtree(p) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('__pycache__')]"
scripts.lint: python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(p.read_text()) for p in list(pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')) + list(pathlib.Path('test').rglob('*.py'))]"
scripts.test: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s test -t . -q
